{{Top|leg}}
'''Jesl Berken''' was a [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarian]] [[Scout/Legends|explorer]]<ref name="SWG:TBFM">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Berken's Flow Markers|Mustafar}}</ref> who lived long before the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:BF">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=poi|Berken's Flow|Mustafar}}</ref> Berken was famous for having explored the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] and for having discovered rich mineral deposits in the region that was later named [[Berken's Flow/Legends|Berken's Flow]] after him.<ref name="SWG:TBFM" /> Following its discovery, Berken's Flow was for some times the richest source of natural resources in the galaxy.<ref name="SWG:BF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jesl Berken was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TBFM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Mention of Jesl Berken was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:TBFM" />
